title: PCFL execution bundle v1: D0 CPU reference scope
summary: Bind the exact PCFL mechanism-assay design and permit, only after explicit human ratification of these bytes, D0 implementation and execution of deterministic CPU reference worlds, exact Bayes/no-lifetime and exact-memory controllers, canonical schemas and parsers, lifecycle/provenance/snapshot machinery, deterministic compiler and reader fixtures, estimators, claim linting, and property tests. The full THINK--DREAM--SLEEP--per-life-LoRA architecture and eventual on-policy action--experience flywheel remain represented but dormant. This change permits no model or provider call, model-backed baseline, LoRA training, remote synchronization, GPU execution, locked calibration or confirmation, scientific implementation beyond D0, or scientific claim.
system_thesis: The project tests whether ordinary action--outcome experience can be recurrently re-expressed during DREAM into target-independent local connections, chronologically supported or contradicted, deterministically compiled during SLEEP, transported into a cumulative per-life memory substrate, and reconstructed by recurrent goal-conditioned THINK into better later action; in later separately authorized work, those actions may change future evidence and repeat the loop. Lived episodes, dream-time connection growth, parametric transport, goal-conditioned composition, and future outcome feedback are distinct organs. D0 builds only a CPU reference microscope and its falsifiers; it cannot credit DREAM with verified truth, credit LoRA with discovery, or credit any organ with organism-level behavior.
